If woman, keep P13's LONG wavy dark-brown hair (never short or a complete updo); if man, keep P14's tousled wavy dark-brown hair and angular face. Reference image 2 is the old scene, ONLY for emotional/content understanding, not identity or composition; create the NEW scene below. Precise luminous contemporary Korean fantasy illustration like approved tarot art, elegant detailed brushwork, natural coherent bodies. Practical period-fantasy clothing with restrained decoration, not royal costumes; no crown, throne, extreme gold, piles of wealth, comedy or mockery. Do NOT reuse reference background. No letters, readable writing, numbers, tarot borders/cards/pentacles, logos/watermarks, no blank dark gradient. No phones/clocks/watches/electronics/cars, no pinching small items, no fist near face. Show supported relaxed hands with correct fingers and two arms per person. No gratuitous faces: colleagues/opponents may appear only as small turned-away backs unless specified. Content is a person's ordinary working tendency, not a forecast of actual status or fortune.  IDENTITY MUST NOT BLEND: Completely ignore the face and haircut in the OLD scene reference. The final character must be unmistakably reference1 tarot identity. Male hair has the full voluminous tousled waves and nape strands of P14, NOT short neat old-scene haircut. Female eyes and oval face and long waves must be exactly P13. Male making and creating (siksin): P14 in a rustic bakery at sunrise, proudly lifting a wide wooden tray of freshly baked bread from a sturdy counter, BOTH palms securely supporting its two sides from below. Calm satisfied smile with amber eyes open, exact full P14 hair, white rolled linen sleeves and plain forest-green apron. Warm oven bricks behind him, flour-dusted workbench and a small bowl of dough at side, morning sunlight through an open window. Three-quarter torso and face close enough for mobile, not a chef in modern stainless kitchen. Simple pleasure in finishing a thing made by his own effort, no pinching garnish, no display of wealth.
